caption: Page 209 of the 1764 Grieve translation of Krasheninnikov's History of Kamtschatka, describing fly-agaric intoxication and urine-drinking among the Koryaks.
alt: Printed 18th-century English page headed "Kamtschatka, &c." with paragraphs describing the Kamtschadales and Koreki eating the mushroom and drinking the urine of the intoxicated.
credit: Internet Archive / R. Raikes (Gloucester) and T. Jefferys (London), 1764
note: This is the actual page (leaf 226, printed page 209) within the cited pp. 207-209 range, found via the Internet Archive search-inside API for "urine". It contains the sentence about the Koreki saving and drinking the urine of a person intoxicated by the mushroom, matching the transcript. Item: historyofkamtsch00kras.
